treatment.logline: Two fluffy companions fiercely debate a mysterious glowing artifact’s true nature, only to realize their conflict stems from a clever play of light and perspective.
treatment.synopsis: In a sun-dappled meadow, Pip discovers a pulsating crystalline object that shifts hue depending on the viewer's angle. When Pop arrives, they interpret the shifting colors as entirely different objects, sparking a heated disagreement over its identity and value. As they circle the artifact, their conflicting viewpoints escalate into a physical standoff until a subtle shift in sunlight reveals a hidden reflective facet causing the refraction illusion. The tension dissolves into shared wonder as they recognize the object's true form, ending with a quiet moment of reconciliation under the same light.
treatment.visual_language: High-key natural lighting with practical lens flares and controlled refraction effects. Soft focus backgrounds to isolate character expressions. Camera angles shift dynamically to mirror subjective perspectives during conflict, resolving to stable, symmetrical wide shots for clarity and emotional release.

beats.action: Pip brushes through tall grass, stops abruptly. A faceted crystal rests on a flat stone, pulsing with warm amber light.

continuity.wardrobe: Soft blue-tinted fur, slightly dusted with pollen

beats.action: Pop enters frame from right, eyes widen. The crystal now reads as cool violet in Pop's sightline.
beats.dialogue: Pop: Wait... that’s not what I thought it was.

beats.action: Pip steps between Pop and the crystal, shielding it.
beats.dialogue: Pip: It’s a Sun-Stone. I found it first.

beats.action: Pop circles left, crystal shifts to magenta.
beats.dialogue: Pop: That’s a Moon-Shard. You’re misreading it.

beats.action: Both step forward, paws raised. The crystal flashes red at Pip, green at Pop.

continuity.wardrobe: Blue & orange fur ruffled by tension

beats.action: Extreme close-ups alternate. Ears flatten, tails twitch. They argue over ownership and truth.
beats.dialogue: Pop: You’re blind to what’s right in front of you!

beats.action: Pop stumbles back slightly. A sunbeam catches a hidden internal mirror in the crystal, casting a sharp white flare across both faces.
The flare fades. The crystal now shows a neutral, unified glow. Both lower their paws.
They step closer together, tilting heads. The crystal refracts into a soft rainbow halo.
beats.dialogue: Pop: It changes with how we look at it.

beats.action: Pip gently nudges Pop’s shoulder. Shared smile.
beats.dialogue: Pip: We were fighting a shadow.

beats.action: Wide shot. They sit side-by-side watching the crystal pulse gently as golden hour light washes over them.

characters.name: Pip
characters.visual_lock: Compact build, blue-tinted fur, expressive ears that flatten during conflict and perk during resolution.
characters.wardrobe: Natural fur texture, subtle pollen dust in early scenes, clean by final shot.
characters.performance: Guarded initially, physically protective, softens into curiosity and reconciliation.

characters.name: Pop
characters.visual_lock: Slightly taller build, orange-tinted fur, steady gaze that breaks into surprise during the illusion reveal.
characters.wardrobe: Natural fur texture, clean throughout, slight wind displacement during standoff.
characters.performance: Assertive and opinionated, escalates to frustration, pivots quickly to shared wonder.

locations.name: Sunlit Meadow Clearing
locations.visual_lock: Flat grassy plane with a central smooth stone pedestal. Dappled overhead canopy creates shifting light pools. Consistent horizon line and background foliage placement.

props.name: Luma-Crystal
props.state: Faceted glass prism with an internal angled mirror. Changes perceived color via viewer angle and sunlight refraction. Maintains physical dimensions; only illumination shifts.

motifs: Circular character movement around central object
Shared spatial proximity as emotional barometer

edit_plan.pacing: Staccato to fluid. Rapid intercutting during SC_003-SC_005 (1-2 sec per shot) to amplify tension, transitioning to held medium/wide shots in SC_007-SC_009 (4-6 sec+) for emotional clarity and resolution.
edit_plan.audio_strategy: Diegetic nature ambience opens track. Tense, rhythmic percussion and low strings underscore disagreement. Dialogue remains sparse; vocalizations and prop rustles carry weight. At SC_006 flare, audio dips to silence for 1 beat, then swells into warm harmonic chords and natural wind as illusion breaks.
edit_plan.transition_strategy: Match cuts on crystal orientation and light flares during circle movement. Whips pan follow character repositioning in SC_003-SC_004. Hard cut at SC_006-B01 flare peak for impact, then dissolve into stable framing. Final fade out on wide shot.
